Databases ship as .sqlite files under mini_dev_data/dev_databases per the README. Client and interaction depend on the system under test, so they are left unknown.

tasks.name: Alien database query in conversational mode (c-Interact)
tasks.notes: Sample file uses mode c-interact (trajectory includes an ask_user tool call).

tasks.notes: instruction.md: the live $DB_TYPE selects DuckDB or Snowflake; create models/marts/marketing/cohort_retention_matrix.sql in schema marketing_analytics. Verified by pytest against the materialised table.

configurations.label: Snowflake

tasks.name: Find third-highest correlated wine feature with pandas in VS Code

tasks.name: ModelOff 2016 round 1 section 2: 'Chip off the old block'
tasks.notes: Data analysis task with questions 6-18 (multiple choice and numeric answers). Language inferred from the evaluation notebooks; engine and file formats not verified.

tasks.name: Build the 'address' ELT pipeline into Snowflake (states model)
tasks.notes: config.yaml: Airbyte public API server, sources aws_s3 (CBSA.jsonl via LocalStack), flat_files (CSV from Google Drive), postgres, mongodb and custom_api; destination Snowflake. data_model.yaml defines target model 'states'. Transformation language not verified.

tasks.name: Calculate wage mean and standard deviation

tasks.name: Train a house price regression model

tasks.notes: The task spec explicitly names the query backend/language in grading facts. Default MCP interface and harness tools are inferred from benchmark-wide README and Dockerfile; CLI-only runs are also supported. No agent run was performed.

tasks.notes: Starter calls pandas.read_parquet and DataFrame.to_parquet. Verification describes the task starter, not an observed agent trajectory.

tasks.notes: Spider 2.0-Lite record with db 'ga4'; the database is listed under spider2-lite/resource/databases/bigquery/. Client and interaction come from the benchmark's BigQuery interface (bigquery.Client()), not from the task record. Output format and physical storage are not stated.

tasks.notes: Spider 2.0-Lite record with db 'E_commerce' (schema JSON and DDL.csv under resource/databases/sqlite/E_commerce/). The .sqlite files are downloaded separately per the README.

tasks.name: Complete dbt project for traffic-source attribution metrics
tasks.notes: profiles.yml declares 'type: duckdb, path: ./playbook.duckdb'; evaluation (gold/spider2_eval.jsonl) uses duckdb_match against playbook.duckdb on table attribution_touches. The .duckdb file itself is downloaded separately.

tasks.name: GA4 engagement question, Snowflake edition
tasks.notes: Spider 2.0-Snow record (db_id 'GA4'); the Snow subset is Snowflake-only. Access via snowflake.connector.connect() with a credential file is the benchmark's reference interface; Snowsight GUI access is also documented.

tasks.name: Load JSONL from Google Drive into a BigQuery table via the web UI
tasks.notes: related_apps: bigquery, chromium; setup launches Google Chrome and logs into BigQuery and Google Drive. Source is data.jsonl plus schema.txt in Drive; the evaluator exports information.data1 to CSV and compares with gold.csv (CSV is an evaluation artifact, not BigQuery's storage).

tasks.name: Filter Airflow DAGs by owner in the Astronomer web UI
tasks.notes: related_apps: airflow, chromium; Airflow deployed locally with Astronomer (astro) at localhost:8080. Orchestration task with no table data.

evidence.notes: SQL execution template uses pandas.read_sql_query and DataFrame.to_csv. This is benchmark runtime support, not an independently verified task.
The SQL tool template calls sqlite3.connect and executes the supplied SQL against the task database.
Notebook execution initializes a pandas DataFrame with read_csv and wraps agent-generated transforms with a pandas DataFrame signature.
Agent analysis tools operate on pandas DataFrames for grouping, visualization and regression.
The example system under test loads CSV inputs as pandas DataFrames. This establishes a supported baseline, not usage by every submitted agent.
Reference pipelines read CSV inputs with pandas and apply tabular and semantic operations.
The text-to-SQL baseline connects to BIRD SQLite databases and executes generated SQL.
Polars is installed, but no active task usage was established. Dependency-only evidence does not contribute to the ranking.
Spark tasks appear on the roadmap, not among the current tasks. Planned support does not contribute to the ranking.
The base execution image installs pandas. This alone does not establish task usage.
The evaluator imports pandas. Evaluator-only imports do not establish the data engine used by an agent and are excluded.
The benchmark deploys Prometheus telemetry through its concrete service wrapper.
Agent MCP tools call the dedicated Prometheus query and alert APIs.
Prometheus is part of the live SRE observability stack; scenario modes determine which other components are installed.
Altinity ClickHouse is listed as logs/traces storage for ITBench SRE. This is benchmark-level stack support, not a claim that every agent queries it.
Jaeger/OpenSearch traces can be disabled per scenario. Counted as supported benchmark coverage, not universal task usage.
The execution worker initializes pandas in the IPython user namespace; the agent executor explicitly instructs pandas DataFrame analysis.
README says the astronomy-shop bundled OpenSearch/Grafana are not queried by the benchmark. The bundled Jaeger is replaced by a dedicated observer. No OpenSearch coverage credit from this bundle.

excluded_engines.reason: Managed/proprietary services remain in the general matrix, but are outside the open-source engine leaderboard.
